julesThoughtProcess: Dodger Blue selected to provide an atmospheric, technological punch while maintaining a sense of calm and clarity.
storyPanel: At Node 72, beneath the sprawling lattice of the upper concourse, downtime is as essential as uptime. Two engineers catch a quiet moment, the hum of server racks blending with the soft glow of atmospheric processors. Here, the tech doesn't loom—it simply sustains. A rare pocket of peace in a beautifully complex world.
